saveFile.export.title: Export Archive
saveFile.export.subtitle: New format is .epubsave, including portable data and selected book files.
saveFile.export.explain: Reading data includes progress, bookmarks, notes, favorites, and folders. All books includes empty folders; selected books only includes relevant folders. Including book files is independent of data scope.
saveFile.export.includeBooks: Include book files (off by default; enables reading directly on another device)
saveFile.import.title: Import Archive Preview
saveFile.import.subtitle: {source}; preview will not modify the library.
saveFile.import.reason.attachmentFailed: included book file failed to import
saveFile.import.reason.attachmentFailedW: included book file failed to import: {message}
saveFile.import.applyPreferences: Apply appearance settings from archive (only themes, font size, line height, etc.)
saveFile.import.explain: Confirming will merge data into your current library. Only books already on this device or included in the archive are accepted; progress, notes, favorites and categories for other books are not imported.
saveFile.progress.tooLate: Operation cannot be rolled back, waiting for results.
saveFile.progress.committed: Commit has started; closing the window will not roll back.
